mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a canonical Trend Intensity Index crossing its 50 midline on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies a change in whether positive or negative deviations from the major trend dominate; follow the new dominant side for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when TII crosses strictly above 50 from at or below 50; short when it crosses strictly below 50 from at or above 50
mechanism.why_distinct: HVTII measures the share of absolute deviations from a 60-period simple moving average contributed by positive deviations over a separate 30-period window. It is not a return oscillator, candle-range ratio, volume/flow measure, OI, funding, premium, or Gross9 primitive.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, restricting trend-deviation dominance changes to July-like volatile conditions
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour two-window deviation-share midline clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.major_average: simple mean of the latest 60 consecutive valid completed four-hour closes
features.deviation: current completed close minus current major average
features.trend_intensity_index: 100 times the rolling 30-period sum of positive deviations divided by the rolling 30-period sum of absolute deviations; denominator finite and strictly positive
features.cross: strict current crossing of 50 from the immediately prior valid TII
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Trend Intensity Index 50-midline crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no TII formula, period, midline, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.origin: M. H. Pee, canonical Trend Intensity Index convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: 60-period close SMA; over the latest 30 completed deviations, TII=100*sum(max(close-SMA,0))/sum(abs(close-SMA)); 50 midline and strict crossing
external_basis.selection_use: published 60/30 formula, midline, and direction only; no incidence or outcomes
